legend: Diffuse infiltration of large oval cells and scattered hallmark cells; there are frequent mitoses (<<31206>>). Pleomorphic cells are admixed with reactive lymphocytes in the background. FISH for DUSP22 rearrangement was negative (<<31207>>). CD30 highlights clusters of lymphoma cells with a sinusoidal pattern (<<31208>>). CD30 highlights lymphoma cells in a paracortical/perifollicular pattern (<<31209>>).

Large anaplastic lymphoma cells, including hallmark cells, are seen in lung involved by ALK-negative ALCL (<<31210>>).
